title: phyllanthus benthamianus
intro: Phyllanthus benthamianus, commonly known as the 'Thorny Spurge', is a species of plant in the family Phyllanthaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Phyllanthus benthamianus include anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Phyllanthus benthamianus on human health, but its potential uses in treating various ailments make it an area of ongoing interest.
